purpose: Define the minimum adversarial scope for an external review of Anup Nifty Valuation without allowing the model author to redefine the test after seeing findings.

review_target.rule: Review one immutable commit SHA, never a moving branch.

reviewer_must_not_have_authored: the independent reimplementation used for replication
reviewer_rights: request raw source evidence and hashes
independence_minimum.note: A second AI critique, a rerun of repository code, or author-supervised confirmation is useful challenge but is not independent model validation by itself.

required_falsification_work.task: Reimplement the current target independently from frozen rules and raw published inputs without calling model.js or copying its calculation functions.

Audit data lineage and point-in-time availability, including observation date versus release date, revisions, stale fallbacks, source-shape changes, duplicated records and missing-data refusal behavior.

Challenge valuation reference choice and calibration fragility; reproduce reference sensitivity and leave-block recalibration, and test whether conclusions depend on the short current-definition regime.
Quantify lens redundancy and covariance; test whether the four displayed lenses materially overstate independent information content.
Rebuild the historical evaluator independently with total-return benchmarks, execution lag, drift-aware turnover, exposure-matched nulls, serial dependence and all comparable attempted variants.
Price the SMA10 brake as insurance: separate crash drawdown reduction, premium paid, engagement timing, gap risk and recovery participation.

Challenge implementation realism using actual investable vehicles. Separate costs embedded in NAV from investor-level turnover costs, exit loads and tax-lot effects; do not infer after-tax superiority when tax reconstruction is unavailable.

Attempt deployment and UI failure modes: stale page shell, stale JSON, mismatched timestamps, unsupported schema, partial refresh and cache divergence. Verify that the system withholds rather than fabricates a target when live-required evidence is invalid.

Search deliberately for analyses that make the model look worse, including alternative fair references, subperiods, plausible comparator definitions and source-timing assumptions. Record every additional comparable trial.

required_deliverables: reproducible finding log with severity and counterexample
list of untestable claims and missing data
explicit treatment of every material adverse repository result
final use decision limited to the scope actually tested
acceptance.unresolved_rule: Material unresolved findings remain public and prevent a blanket validated or institutional-grade claim.
acceptance.no_composite_override: A high engineering/governance score cannot average away failed evidence, data-lineage or independence gates.

prohibited_shortcuts: Treating successful CI as evidence of investment efficacy
Treating reproduction of the author's own implementation as independent replication
Changing thresholds after seeing review results without creating a new version and trial entry
Using one favorable backtest to override contrary placebo, bootstrap, PBO or prospective evidence
Calling the strategy after-tax validated while investor tax lots or historical tax rules remain unreconstructed
